name: PORTABLE VERTICAL AUTOCLAVE
desc: Microprocessor-Controlled Double-Walled Portable Vertical Autoclave engineered for reliable steam sterilization in medical laboratories and clinical centers. Features a 22-liter sterilization chamber entirely constructed from high-grade Stainless Steel 304 (SS304) for both inner and outer walls.
features: High-Grade Stainless Steel (SS304) for both inner and outer chambers
15 psi to 20 psi regulated sterilization pressure levels
Heavy lid locking system backed by high-durability Silicon Gasket

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Premium Double-Walled Portable Vertical Autoclave Sterilizer
specifications.Primary Functional Application: High-pressure saturated steam sterilization of lab instruments and media
specifications.Material of Construction (MOC): High-Grade Stainless Steel (SS304) for both inner and outer chambers
specifications.Internal Structural Build: Dual-chambered double-walled insulation construction preventing heat loss
specifications.Operating Steam Pressure Range: 15 psi to 20 psi regulated sterilization pressure levels
specifications.Sterilization Temperature Scale: Precise thermal tracking from 121 degrees C to 125 degrees C
specifications.Core Controller Architecture: Integrated advanced Microprocessor-Based Digital Controller panel
specifications.Thermal Heating Elements: High-durability immersion type element fabricated from SS304 grade steel
specifications.Pressure Monitoring Gauge: Heavy-duty front-mounted analog dial gauge for instant pressure tracking
specifications.Chamber Sealing Mechanism: Heavy lid locking system backed by high-durability high-temperature Silicon Gasket
specifications.Exhaust Safety Provisions: Heavy-duty multi-turn manual Steam Release Valve mechanism
specifications.Main Drain Utility Loop: Built-in water drain valve for quick cleaning and residue clearing
specifications.Electrical Power Interface: Standard 230 V AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug profile
specifications.Target Field Applications: Medical Pathology, Clinical Diagnostics, University Labs, and Biotech setups
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on controller and vessel
